errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Gesetzlicher Mindestlohn (Jahresmittelwert)" beschriftet
errors.evidence: The vertical axis measures hourly wage in Euro, not just the statutory minimum wage.
The description does not mention that the vertical axis has tick intervals of 2 Euro.
The description does not mention that the bars are presented side by side rather than stacked.

errors.text_span: Für 2015 beträgt der Wert des violetten Balkens 8,50 Euro pro Stunde
errors.evidence: The blue bar represents the statutory minimum wage, not the purple one.
The description does not mention the chart’s purpose related to minimum wage trends.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für 2015 bis 2024 sind in einer Farbpalette von hellen Violett- und Rosa-Tönen dargestellt
errors.evidence: The bars for the 'gesetzlichen Mindestlohn' are shown in light blue, not in violet and pink tones.
The description does not mention the dashed area for the years 2024 and 2025.
